description: The render_visual arguments. Also the source of the input schema the host sees.

subtitle.description: Optional subtitle, plain text, e.g. the unit and period: 'EUR, FY2025'.

chart_type.description: variance compares actuals with a scenario (needs Val plus PY, PM, PL or FC); bar and pin show one series; waterfall shows contributions; line and area show trends over time.

category_columns.description: Category column(s). One column, or two for a hierarchy (parent first). A time axis cannot be part of a hierarchy.

time_axis.description: Set when the category column is a time period, so it is drawn as a chart: year for integer years (2025), semester for half-years (H1 or 2025-H1), quarter for quarters (Q1 or 2025-Q1), month for month names (Jan or January), yearmonth for YYYY-MM (2025-01), date for days as YYYY-MM-DD (2025-01-31). Send the rows in time order. Leave it out for any other category.

measure.description: Measure on the value axis. Values are column names from columns.

name.description: Display name of the measure, e.g. 'Revenue'.

PM.description: Column with previous-month values. Use either PY or PM, not both.

PL.description: Column with plan or budget values.

negative_impact.description: True when an increase is bad, e.g. costs or expenses. Flips the variance colours.

sort_by.description: Scenario or variance to sort categories by. Ignored for a time_axis and line or area charts.

rows.description: Pre-aggregated rows in the order of columns, one per category combination.
